defect_1.root_cause: prepare_export hashed the frozen packet over native pre-transport doubles; Godot full-precision JSON formatting is not idempotent across a parse for accumulated fixed-tick movement doubles, so the target recomputed a different checksum over the delivered byte-identical packet and rejected every legitimate handoff with real accumulated movement
defect_1.repair: producer-side canonicalization to a JSON round-trip fixed point before checksum computation; collapsed mismatch split into ABSENT/CHECKSUM_INVALID/PACKET_DIVERGED; gate strictness unchanged

defect_2.found_in: R13 manual rerun after the attestation repair (route already completed)
defect_2.root_cause: interactive clients submit one distinct fixed-tick operation per held tick (~120 ops/s for two players); gateway ledger capacity 1024 exhausted in ~8.6 s of held movement; the P6 ledger is fail-closed with no eviction, so the bound was mis-sized
defect_2.repair: MAX_INTERACTIVE_LEDGER_OPERATIONS = 16384 derived from the session envelope (2 x 60 x 120 = 14400) plus headroom; retirement policy unchanged
